6. Progress Bar Show/Hide Logic - Automatic with ProgressManager

algorithm_details.complexity: O(V + E) where V=videos, E=duplicate pairs
steps: 1. Build graph: videos as nodes, duplicate pairs as edges (filtered by threshold)
2. For each unvisited node, start DFS to find component
3. DFS traverses all reachable nodes via connections
6. Find representative (max degree, then max avg_similarity, then max size)
algorithm_details.representative_criteria: 1st: highest degree | 2nd: highest avg similarity | 3rd: largest file size
